crossRefs.note: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring…
Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have…
Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they would do according…
that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.
translations.bsb: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
translations.kjv: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
